text: The library stays open until seven on weekdays. The front desk can help you renew your books.
I left the spare key under the blue flowerpot. Please lock the kitchen door before you leave.
The north elevator is being repaired this morning. Take the stairs beside the coffee shop to reach the second floor.
We will meet at the station shortly after sunrise. Bring a warm jacket and pack something to drink. If the train is delayed, wait by the ticket office and send me a message.

When you arrive at the museum, follow the path across the courtyard. Our guide will be waiting beside the fountain. We have time to see the photography exhibit before lunch, so there is no need to rush.

The community garden opens early on Saturday. Volunteers should bring gloves, a water bottle, and a hat. We will clear the footpath first, then set out the new plants and mark each row with a wooden sign.
Xin chào, chúc bạn một ngày tốt lành.
Chuyến tàu cuối cùng sẽ rời ga vào lúc chín giờ tối. Bạn có thể mua vé ở quầy bên trái.
Sáng thứ bảy, chúng tôi sẽ gặp nhau ở cổng công viên. Bạn nhớ mang theo nước uống và một chiếc áo khoác nhẹ. Nếu trời mưa, cả nhóm sẽ chuyển sang phòng đọc sách gần đó.
